scholarships.title: Bolsas Capacitacao de Curta Duracao no Exterior - Edital Comite Gestor Fiocruz no 02/2026 (CAPES-Global.Edu)

existing.description: The second of the five editais opened by the Managing Committee of Fiocruz for the 2027 activity year. This call covers the CAPES-Global.Edu modality Capacitacao de curta duracao no Exterior, short-term training abroad. Unlike the sandwich-doctorate call, it is open not only to Fiocruz master's and doctoral students registered on Sucupira but also to Fiocruz teaching staff, researchers and technical staff who hold a formal employment relationship (CLT or statutory) with the institution and are involved in graduate-programme activities. The purpose is individual qualification and institutional strengthening through technical, scientific or pedagogical training courses abroad, expressly excluding language training. Each candidate may register for only one of the five Fiocruz editais, and multiple registrations are automatically voided.
eligibility: Be formally linked to Fiocruz with a formal employment relationship (CLT or statutory) as teaching staff, researcher or technical professional, and be involved in activities linked to a graduate programme that belongs to the CAPES Global network
OR be a master's or doctoral student duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as a student of a Fiocruz graduate programme that belongs to the CAPES Global network
Be linked to the strategic themes of the Rede CAPES Global para o Desenvolvimento Sustentavel, Ciencia e Saude, per Annex I
Register for only one of the five editais of the Comite Gestor; registering in more than one voids all registrations without exception
Candidates already in process under earlier editais will be considered under only one candidature, the first submission being valid and the rest annulled
existing.eligibility_summary: People formally linked to Fiocruz: (a) teaching staff, researchers and technical professionals with a formal (CLT or statutory) employment relationship with Fundacao Oswaldo Cruz who support graduate-programme teaching, research, extension and internationalisation activities, and (b) master's or doctoral students duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as students of a Fiocruz graduate programme. In both cases the candidate's graduate programme must be linked to the CAPES Global network's strategic themes listed in Annex I.
benefits: Short-term training placement abroad (treinamentos, cursos tecnicos, cientificos or pedagogicos), expressly excluding language training
Start of overseas activities in September and October 2027
coverage: Short-term technical, scientific or pedagogical training abroad for Fiocruz staff, researchers and postgraduates
Institutional strengthening of the human resources of the participating graduate programmes
requirements: Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form published on the call page
If this is a first access to the Fiocruz site, register beforehand using the link provided on the application page
Choose a single modality among the five Fiocruz editais
Accept the conditions of the Edital, from which no later ignorance may be claimed
documents: Anexo I - Temas Estrategicos CG Fiocruz
Anexo II - Plano de Atividade Capacitacao
Anexo III - Qualificacao de parceria internacional
Anexo IV - Autodeclaracao de atividades no exterior
Anexo V - Carta de apoio do orientador (discente)
Anexo VI - Carta de apoio do PPG e da chefia (profissionais)
Anexo VII - Carta de aceite da instituicao de ensino superior no exterior
Anexo VIII - Declaracao de fluencia linguistica (profissionais)
Anexo IX - Declaracao de fluencia linguistica (orientador do discente)
application_method: Online application form on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual editais platform
existing.selection_notes: All results and any appeals are published exclusively on the call page, strictly following the edital schedule. The call page does not publish selection criteria, weighting or financial values.
existing.best_fit: Fiocruz teaching staff, researchers or technical professionals, and Fiocruz master's or doctoral students, who need a short technical, scientific or pedagogical training period abroad and are linked to a graduate programme in the CAPES Global network's strategic themes.
existing.notes: Financial terms come from CAPES Edital no 13/2025 and are not reproduced on the Fiocruz call page, so no amount is claimed. Language training is expressly excluded from this modality. This record is a different funding scheme from the Fiocruz sandwich-doctorate call (Edital 01/2026), which is recorded separately.
existing.application_period: 15/09/2026 to 23/10/2026 (16h, Brasilia time); overseas activities begin September and October 2027
existing.deadline_display: Applications close 23 October 2026 at 16:00 Brasilia time
existing.program_type: Research institute short-term training abroad scholarship administered under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme
